summary: The repository directly constructs the Node SDK in Node 14 and 16 compatibility examples, but the bounded notes do not cover the long 0.30-to-0.217 migration sufficiently to establish an applicable break.
omittedConcerns: The 0.44 removal of sdk-node's explicit Jaeger-exporter dependency is omitted because the supplied repository excerpts do not show Jaeger exporter usage.
The 0.215 LogRecordExporter change is omitted because no custom log exporter is shown.
Runtime and constructor compatibility are not claimed because the supplied notes do not document the intervening NodeSDK migration or supported Node.js versions.
